svg.aria-label: Three nodes, A, B and C, reach the barrier named start at different times, with parties = 3. Each records its arrival, holding the time it arrived, as barriers/start/ followed by its learner ID, and lists that prefix at poll instants every node shares. A arrives first and waits; B arrives next and waits; their polls see one key, then two. C arrives and lists three keys: the barrier opens. Each node reads the arrival times and computes the same release instant; all three wait for it and start training together.
svg.text: C arrives: 3 of 3, the barrier opens
waits, listing barriers/start/ at the shared poll instants
Arrivals hold their time; every node computes the same release from them and waits for it, so all three start at once.
Arrivals are never removed, so a node that reaches start after the release passes at once.
